name: TaskCompletionMetric
reason: The system successfully accessed the specified directory, processed the patient notes, and generated the required summaries in both JSON and Markdown formats containing all requested data points.

reason: The agent performed multiple unnecessary actions, including listing files, updating a plan twice, and saving an intermediate note, all of which were superfluous to the task of reading files and writing the required output files.

reason: The score is 1.00 because the actual output is perfectly aligned with the retrieval context, demonstrating excellent accuracy and faithfulness!
